name: Untale: Korol' Revinii
source:
Medieval Revinia… A small peaceful kingdom at the ends of the earth…

One night changes it forever… One mysterious death. One ancient curse.

Did King Gerard die in his bed? A conspiracy? Or the ancient curse of the Statue of the Beseecher?

Now it is YOUR turn to take the reins of power in your hands! Who else is to govern Revinia if not the son of the dead king?

What relations will YOU establish with the nobles? Will your people like you? Will you find your love when everything is in a state of chaos? Each step is unique. You’re to assemble a life puzzle, but be wise - YOUR CHOICE HAS POWER.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1324830/Untale_King_of_Revinia/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
中世纪的雷维尼亚……天涯海角的一个和平小王国……

一个夜晚永远改变了一切……一场神秘的死亡。一种古老的诅咒。

杰拉德国王死在床上吗？阴谋？还是祈求者雕像的古老诅咒？

现在轮到你来掌控权力了！如果不是已故国王的儿子，还有谁可以统治雷维尼亚？

你将与贵族建立什么关系？你的人民会喜欢你吗？当一切都处于混乱状态时，你会找到你的爱吗？每一步都是独特的。你要拼出一个人生拼图，但要明智——你的选择具有力量。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1324830/Untale_King_of_Revinia/]Steam[/url]]
